blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Pia Cayetano on Thursday said she could not hide her “disdain” on the line of questioning of the prosecution in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte when it touched on the purchase of shoes of respondent’s spouse Manases Carpio intended for his son and other athletes and their guardians. Cayetano made the remark during the testimony of Chadrin Parian, one of the parents of a player in Elite Philippines, the youth basketball team where Carpio serves as a manager.
